mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in FEDFUNDS turns positive (signaling rate hikes), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days tend to be negative due to higher discount rates reducing future cash flows.
failure_condition: Over 20 backtests, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in PAYEMS (labor market tightness) coincides with positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as strong hiring expectations boost market sentiment.
failure_condition: In 50 backtests, positive signal does not predict positive returns (IC < -0.1) or returns are flat (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (industrial production) grows faster than GDP deflator (CPIAUCSL), it indicates robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Across 100 backtests, the interaction signal is present but does not yield statistically significant positive 5-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO (industrial production) for two consecutive months predicts negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to supply-side weakness.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly < previous month for 2 months
failure_condition: In 40 backtests, the signal triggers but 20-day returns remain non-negative (median return ≤ 0).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3%, it reflects labor market slack and is associated with negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns due to reduced wage growth expectations.
failure_condition: Over 30 backtests, the signal occurs but 60-day returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in GDPC1 (consumer demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) for three months predict positive S&P 20-day forward returns as confidence in growth rises.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 monthly > previous and RSAFS monthly > previous for 3 months
failure_condition: In 50 backtests, the interaction is present but does not predict positive 20-day returns (IC > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in PAYEMS accompanied by a decline in UNRATE (labor market tightness vs. slack) predicts positive S&P 5-day forward returns as hiring momentum outweighs wage concerns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly > previous by > 8% AND UNRATE monthly < previous
failure_condition: Across 100 backtests, the interaction does not yield statistically significant positive 5-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO remains flat for four consecutive months, S&P 20-day forward returns tend to be negative due to persistent supply-side stagnation and reduced growth expectations.
failure_condition: In 40 backtests, the flat signal occurs but 20-day returns are not consistently negative (median return ≥ 0).
